messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: How install packages from package.tar.gz?
parts:
Hi guys,
Could you help me?
I am trying to install one package not hosted on Cran by the file "package.tar.gz".

I am using:

install.packages("D:/home/local/shiny/R/site-library/package.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source").

or

sudo su - -c "R -q -e "install.packages('D:/home/local/shiny/R/site-library/package.tar.gz', repos=NULL')""

It does not work on the server but works on my machine. Then, I copied and pasted on server R library the PACKAGE installed folder. I got the Error: cannot open the connection

Thank you

Obs. I am using the shiny.server from my server

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: How install packages from package.tar.gz?
parts:
shinyapps.io does not support usage of install.packages in the ui.R or server.R code itself.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#using-your-r-packages-in-the-cloud
